g_a57d679e5a86.title: Invoice CSV export script for finance

anchorAsk.text: Finance wants a CSV dump of the invoices table from one of our db.json files. Can you add a small script, scripts/export_invoices.py DB_PATH OUT_CSV, that writes one row per invoice with the columns number, customer, amount, due_date? Make a little sample db with a few invoices to try it on.
